svg.title: Five LP12 circular pattern around LP20 Ethernet
svg.desc: Dimensions in mm. Material 6.35 mm acrylic. No kerf offset. LP12 single-flat D cutouts diameter 12.10 mm, overall height 11.60 mm. Two M10 clearance holes diameter 10.20 mm. Existing perimeter and six fixing holes preserved. LP20 Ethernet double-flat opening: diameter 22.60 mm, 20.50 mm across flats. Pressure capacity and connector nut engagement not validated. Revision replaces three LP12 openings with five on a 76 mm pitch circle centered on Ethernet, at 54 + 72*k degrees in DXF coordinates. Perimeter, fixing holes, Ethernet and M10 contours retained. Nut, seal, panel-thread engagement and pressure qualification pending.
